label: Native cloud integration (cbbackupmgr)
type: cbbackupmgr's ability to write a backup archive directly to a cloud object store (object-store:aws-s3/azure-blob-storage/gcp-storage/azure-data-lake-storage-gen2) without a filesystem mount in between. An Enterprise Edition feature, introduced in Couchbase Server 6.6.0.
aliases_note: Folds a same-round self-fork: two batches dispatched together in round 19, working concurrently with no visibility into each other's mints, independently named this exact concept twice - backup:native-cloud-integration (2 files) and backup:cloud-integration (4 files), both carrying the identical label 'Native cloud integration (cbbackupmgr)'. Zero file overlap, 6 distinct files total. The round's dispatch briefing had warned about two OTHER specific collisions (js-udf: vs eventing:, object-store: vs cloud-provider:) and caught both; it said nothing about this one, and this one happened anyway - the warned-about collisions were caught precisely because someone had already thought to warn about them.
evidence: Native cloud integration is an Enterprise Edition feature which was introduced in Couchbase Server 6.6.0.
relates_to_competency_question: Can cbbackupmgr write a backup straight to S3/Azure/GCS, or does it always need a mounted filesystem first?
